observations.measurement_context: (1) Puncture Strength is Greater than 0.14 N/m. Puncture strength is a value showing the strength of films with respect to that of sharp articles. When the films are used for battery separators, if the puncture strength is not sufficient, the films are broken due to abnormality on the surface of electrodes or dendrite occurring on the surface of electrodes when using batteries, and short may occur. The films having the puncture strength of greater than 0.14 N/μm according to the present invention may be used safety for the secondary battery separators.
